about: T-459 D: words under words -- once THE SUBTLE LAYER is held, a purple line after some people's lines, what is meant under what is said. The user chose four (2026-10-28): MOM's ship line, "Come back."; the CHECKPOINT's goodbye, "Not too soon."; CRYSTAL's "...further than I did", "I cannot always be there."; the CHAMPION's "I thought it would be you.", "Before you can." MOM and the CHECKPOINT are played here; CRYSTAL's rating scene and the CHAMPION's room are read from the ROM. The theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's.
